newsitem.title: USA: EIS International may take '96, Q1 charges.
newsitem.headline: EIS International may take '96, Q1 charges.

text.p: EIS International Inc said Friday it might take a charge in the first quarter because of organizational changes aimed at refocusing its core business.

The company also said it might incur further charges against 1996 results stemming from management's analysis of businesses EIS acquired last year and the value of those businesses' related intangible assets.
EIS did not give financial details or say how the charges would affect earnings. An EIS spokeswoman declined comment.
EIS shares stood at six Friday afternoon, compared with 31-5/8 last summer.
